notes.text: SPLIT MODEL: paga_base (changes each tranche) + contingenza (frozen) + EDR (frozen at 10.33). Tranche 1: 01/04/2025; Tranche 2: 01/03/2027. Source: FILLEA CGIL testo armonizzato 15/04/2025 (Art. 25 and tabelle allegate).
CONGLOBATED CHECK: L1 01/04/2025 total 1611.78 / 173 = 9.317 (non-integer). L4 = 2055.65 / 173 = 11.88 (matches official hourly table). Split model confirmed.
HOURLY DIVISOR: 173, from Art. 25 CCNL: 'dividendo per 173 i valori minimi mensili'. Confirmed by official hourly rate column in FILLEA CGIL salary table.

ITS (Indennita' Territoriale di Settore) not modelled: varies by province/region. National table footnote: 'A questa Tabella occorre aggiungere l'ITS che varia da territorio a territorio'. The national tabular minimum does not include ITS.

limitation.remediation: Model the ITS with a fact naming the province, or take it as a second-level element, then remove this limitation.

notes.text: CASSA EDILE: the operai are owed the gratifica natalizia and the ferie as a 18.5% of the pay paid to the Edilcassa (Art. 16 and 18), not a tredicesima from the employer; the file pays them a direct 13th month, so the net, the employer cost and the Edilcassa contribution are all off.

limitation.remediation: Model the operai in a file of their own with 12 monthly payments and the 18.5% Edilcassa accrual, as edilizia-ance does.

notes.text: ADDITIONAL_MONTHS: the file pays 13 monthly payments to every level. The impiegati are owed a tredicesima (Art. 63) and a premio annuo of one monthly payment on 30 June (Art. 64), 14 in all, and after twenty years with the employer a premio di fedeltà (Art. 65); the premio annuo is not paid and the TFR and accruals read 13.

limitation.remediation: Model the impiegati in a file of their own with 14 monthly payments (Art. 63-64), as edilizia-ance-impiegati does.

notes.text: SENIORITY: Art. 49 lists impiegati scatti biennali by category. Level 1 has no explicit Art. 49 amount; engine uses 8.22 (Impiegati 4a category, same as level 2) as an approximation. For operai (levels 1-4), seniority is governed by the Cassa Edile anzianita' professionale edile (APE) system; engine uses the Art. 49 impiegati amounts as an approximation.

limitation.remediation: Give the operai levels no scatti (APE paid by the Cassa Edile) and source the level 1 amount of Art. 49.

notes.text: EVR (Elemento Variabile della Retribuzione): conditional, company/territory-specific bonus. Not modelled.

limitation.remediation: Add the provincial EVR as an input.

notes.text: INPS: reuses 2026-edilizia.json (the edilizia rates by employer size and worker category). Cassa Edile ~18.5% contribution is separate and not included in INPS rates (review of 2026-10-30)

SIMPLIFICATION: Apprenticeship destination conflicts. Art. G defines 4 operai groups and 3 impiegati bands. Engine tracks use disjoint destination_levels: level '2' -> gruppo_4 (36m); level '3' -> gruppo_3 (48m, ref=L2); levels '4'/'5' -> gruppo_2 (51m, ref=L3); levels '6'/'7' -> gruppo_1 (60m, ref=L3). Level '1' has no apprenticeship track (manual labor). Operai gruppo_3 (also exits at level '2', 48m) not modelled separately.

limitation.remediation: Model the operai gruppo 3 track (48 months, exit at level 2) separately and select it by track name.

notes.text: SIMPLIFICATION: Apprentice base per Art. G includes ITS and EVR alongside paga_base + contingenza. Engine covers only paga_base + contingenza; apprentice gross is understated where ITS applies.

limitation.remediation: Add ITS and EVR to the apprentice base of Art. G.

notes.text: APPRENTICE SENIORITY: the CCNL text read for this ruleset does not state whether apprentices accrue the level seniority increments or an amount of their own, and no apprentice amount is modelled. The engine pays no increment during the apprenticeship (provisional); the run is affected when the apprentice has matured increments the level pays.

limitation.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on apprentice seniority and model it as seniority_increments.apprentice_amount (zero when apprentices accrue none), then remove this note.

notes.text: The Fondapi contractual contribution (10 EUR riparametrati a month) is owed on every run that pays the month, in full; the Scheda states no rule for a partly employed month, a part-time worker or the extra months: a partial month or part time pays the full amount, an extra-month run none.

limitation.remediation: Source the rule of the CCNL Confapi Aniem for a partial month and part time and model it, then remove this note.

provenance.note: Number of monthly payments read from the contract file; no clause is cited for it.

reviews.scope: Second review of the edilizia group: minimi of the seven levels in the two tranches and the monthly payments, against the testo armonizzato of the renewal of 15 April 2025.
findings: The 14 minimi match Allegato A (operai, p. 187) and Allegato B (impiegati, p. 188) from 1 April 2025 and 1 March 2027: verified.

Monthly payments: the single file pays 13 to all levels, but the impiegati are owed 14 (Art. 63-64) and the operai a 18.5% to the Edilcassa instead of a tredicesima (Art. 16, 18). Both gaps were info notes; they are now limitations that block the runs they concern. The 13 stays assumed.

reviews.scope: The accrual rule of the tredicesima (fractions of a month) against the full CCNL text.
findings: Articolo 63 - Tredicesima mensilita' (Parte II, impiegati) (p. 95): "La frazione di mese non superiore ai quindici giorni non va considerata mentre deve essere considerata come mese intero la frazione di mese superiore ai quindici giorni.". Match: more_than 15.
